name: 数据库巡检 — 日常巡检流程与检查项
description: Oracle 数据库日常巡检规则。提供每日/每周/每月巡检检查清单，覆盖空间、性能、备份、安全、日志等维度。自动化巡检脚本参考。

skip_when.desc: 自动化巡检已覆盖所有检查项

root_causes.name: 表空间空间不足
root_causes.desc: 表空间使用率超过告警阈值。

root_causes.name: 备份异常
root_causes.desc: RMAN 备份失败或长时间未执行。

root_causes.name: alert log 有错误
root_causes.desc: alert log 中出现 ORA- 错误未处理。

root_causes.name: 性能基线偏移
root_causes.desc: 关键性能指标偏离基线（响应时间、吞吐量）。

step1_ts_usage.sql: SELECT tablespace_name, ROUND(used_percent,1) AS used_pct FROM DBA_TABLESPACE_USAGE_METRICS WHERE used_percent > 80 ORDER BY used_percent DESC

step2_backup_status.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_backup_count FROM v$rman_backup_job_details WHERE start_time > SYSDATE - 2 AND status != 'COMPLETED'

step3_alert_errors.desc: 检查最近 alert log 错误
step3_alert_errors.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ora_error_count FROM v$diag_alert_ext WHERE message_text LIKE '%ORA-%' AND originating_timestamp > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24' HOUR

step4_performance.sql: SELECT metric_name, ROUND(value,2) AS value, metric_unit FROM v$sysmetric WHERE metric_name IN ('Database CPU Time Ratio','Database Wait Time Ratio','User Transaction Per Sec','Physical Reads Per Sec','Average Active Sessions') AND group_id = 2 ORDER BY metric_name

step5_invalid_objects.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM DBA_OBJECTS WHERE status = 'INVALID'

step6_session_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_sessions, ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT TO_NUMBER(value) FROM v$parameter WHERE name='sessions'),0) * 100, 1) AS session_pct FROM v$session WHERE type = 'USER'
